transcript.answer: Otto deploys with Helm to the shared GKE Autopilot cluster `n8n-cluster` in `europe-west1`, so the Cloud Run plan in `europe-north1` (issue #27) was never built. ADR-003 (decided 2026-10-19) says the region choice rested on the model running in `europe-north1`, 'in the same region as the Vertex model'. That premise no longer holds. Measured on 2026-10-16, `europe-north1` serves only the Gemini 2.5 family, which Google retires on 2026-10-20. The newer Gemini models answer only on the `eu` multi-region. The ADR lists Cloud Run in `europe-north1` under 'Rejected alternatives'. It says the plan rested on that model-region assumption and on terraform roots (`shared/`, `environments/poc/`, `bootstrap/`, a `deploy-poc.yaml` workflow) that the repo never built. The ADR also rejects the model's `global` endpoint, because it gives up the EU residency the model allowlist exists to enforce. Issues #27, #162 and #168 were closed as superseded. The planned `docs/adr/ADR-001-hosting-platform.md` was never written, and ADR-003 replaces it.

judgements.reason: The answer covers the essentials: on 2026-10-16 europe-north1 served only Gemini 2.5, which retired on 2026-10-20, and newer models answer only on the eu multi-region, so Otto runs on GKE Autopilot n8n-cluster in europe-west1.
